Landing.title: Aldebyani Home Care
Landing.heading: Home services, priced up front.
Landing.body: Post what you need, choose a provider, and pay them in cash after the job.

Login.title: Welcome
Login.intro: Enter your mobile number and we will send you a code.
Login.codeSent: We sent a 6 digit code to <phone>{number}</phone>.
Login.noRegion: Sign in is not available right now. Nothing changed. Please try again later.

errors.not_mobile: This is not a mobile number. Enter your mobile number, starting with 5.
errors.too_short: This number is too short. Enter all the digits, like 555 123 45 67.
errors.other_country: We only serve numbers starting with {dialCode} for now.
errors.phone_not_supported: We cannot send a code to this number. Check it and try a mobile number.
errors.limit_phone: A code was sent to this number moments ago. Wait a minute, then ask for a new one.
errors.limit_ip: Too many attempts from this connection. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.limit_sms_cap: We are sending many codes right now. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.limit_sends: Too many codes for this number. Wait 10 minutes and try again.
errors.limit_checks: Too many wrong tries. Ask for a new code.
errors.bot_check_failed: The security check did not pass. Try again.
errors.bot_unavailable: The security check could not load. Nothing was sent. Check your connection and try again.
errors.send_failed: We could not send the code. Nothing changed. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: We could not reach the server. Nothing changed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.wrong_or_expired: This code is wrong or has expired. Check it, or ask for a new code.

Onboarding.title: How will you use Aldebyani?
Onboarding.intro: We ask this once, when you first sign up. One number holds one role.
Onboarding.customerPoint1: Post a request at a fixed price
Onboarding.customerPoint2: Compare offers and choose a provider
Onboarding.customerPoint3: Pay the commission online, and the rest in cash after the job
Onboarding.providerPoint2: Pay the provider fee only when a customer chooses you
Onboarding.providerPoint3: Apply once the admin approves your profile
Onboarding.agreement: [draft] I accept the <terms>terms</terms> and the <privacy>privacy notice</privacy>, and I agree that the platform may take legal action if one of the two parties does something wrong.
Onboarding.nextCustomer: Next, you post your first request.

Legal.termsBody: [draft] These terms are a draft and are being reviewed. The service contract and the cash payment are between the customer and the provider. We connect them and take only our two fees.
Legal.privacyBody: [draft] This notice is a draft and is being reviewed. We use your mobile number to sign you in, and share it with the provider or customer only after both of you have paid.
